# `make_ym_interval`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Make year-month interval from years, months.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
make_ym_interval([years[, months]])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_ym_interval, example 1
> SELECT make_ym_interval(1, 2);
1-2
```

```sql
-- make_ym_interval, example 2
> SELECT make_ym_interval(1, 0);
1-0
```

```sql
-- make_ym_interval, example 3
> SELECT make_ym_interval(-1, 1);
-0-11
```

```sql
-- make_ym_interval, example 4
> SELECT make_ym_interval(2);
2-0
```
